title: MergeRetention
description: One attributed file measured at pull request merge.

org_id.description: The deployment's tenant id, normalized. Bound to the server.

repo.description: `owner/repo`, lowercased. Empty string when the sender omitted it.

pr_number.description: The positive pull request number within the repository.

merge_id.description: Stable id for this pull request merge boundary.

inference_call_id.description: Id of the inference call this record belongs to.

session_id.description: The coding-agent session this belongs to (ADR 0002).

head_commit_sha.description: The final pull request head commit.

head_file_path.description: The source path resolved at the final pull request head.

merge_file_path.description: The source path resolved at the merged commit boundary.

head_retention_score.description: Four-gram containment of the source addition at the final head.

merge_retention_score.description: Four-gram containment of the source addition at the merged commit.

attribution_source.description: How the underlying attribution was established.

attribution_similarity_score.description: The similarity score from the source Attribution.

provenance.description: The structured provenance for this artifact.

session_commit_observation_ids.description: Sorted unique observations of the Session on the source commit. The selected call/file Attribution remains inferred.

quarantine_revision.description: The integer quarantine-log high-water mark used for the derivation.

policy_digest.description: SHA-256 of the fully resolved derivation policy when available.
